sessions.name: broker-order-entry
sessions.lifecycle: active across opening, residual cancel, fresh flatten observation, flatten and reconciliation

sessions.name: flatten-market-observation
sessions.lifecycle: new clean session after opening terminal CumQty and persisted Fill sum agree
sessions.subscription_contract: 263=1 then 263=2 with the same unique MDReqID
sessions.freshness_contract: startedAtUtc >= openingTerminalUtc; observedAtUtc >= startedAtUtc; nowUtc - observedAtUtc <= 5 seconds
sessions.cleanup_contract: economic BBO frozen first; unsubscribe and logout share one cancellable budget; force-close then stream/socket disposal in finally
sessions.cleanup_deadline_contract: cleanupDeadlineUtc <= lifecycle DeadlineUtc; no write starts when no time remains
sessions.cleanup_task_contract: every started cleanup task is awaited; no fire-and-forget
sessions.cleanup_failure_effect: immutable sanitized diagnostics after a valid BBO; flatten remains authorized

communication.market_data_to_execution: immutable content-addressed observation decision passed in process
communication.opening_market_observation_id: persisted in outbound send ledger OPEN row
communication.flatten_market_observation_id: persisted in outbound send ledger FLATTEN row
communication.observation_identity_rule: opening and flatten SHA-256 must be distinct even when bid and ask are numerically equal

freshness_guard.opening_rule: BUY limit equals fresh LMAX ask
freshness_guard.flatten_rule: SELL limit equals newly acquired fresh LMAX bid

restart.fill_quantity_authority: sum of deduplicated PostgreSQL arch7b_fills for the known ClOrdID

no_fresh_flatten_bbo.bounded_wait: up to three five-second SnapshotPlusUpdates attempts and never beyond the global lifecycle deadline
no_fresh_flatten_bbo.operator_state: position remains non-flat and must be treated as unresolved until broker evidence confirms flat

cleanup: unsubscribe with 263=2 and the same MDReqID after the first complete ARCH7B BBO
unsubscribe and logout share a maximum 1000 ms budget capped by the lifecycle deadline
market-data socket force-close, stream disposal and socket disposal per attempt
order-entry logout attempted on every post-logon exit, including fail-closed exits
order-entry socket disposal on every exit
PostgreSQL advisory lease release on every exit
